mapper.select: SELECT mo.id, mo.model_id, mo.optimizer_id, mo.default_lr, mo.create_time, dm.name as model_name, do.name as optimizer_name FROM model_optimizer mo INNER JOIN dict_model dm ON mo.model_id = dm.id INNER JOIN dict_optimizer do ON mo.optimizer_id = do.id WHERE mo.model_id = #{modelId} ORDER BY mo.id ASC
